text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soon after her debut, Air Groove finds herself juggling her work with the student council, guiding the academy's younger students, and of course, pursuing her own ideal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Choosing to trust in her fully, I decide the most suitable upcoming race for the Empress is the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Air Groove wishes to enter the race as well, our next goal is unanimous—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To make Air Groove the queen of the junior year.
